objective: Counter-audit the imported MV3 analyzer, make the separated repository testable, and add missing representative MV3 fixtures without expanding product scope.
acceptanceCriteria: All existing behaviors remain deterministic and local-only.
Tests run from this repository root on Windows and use no hard-coded parent path.
Representative fixtures cover minimal MV3, popup, options, service worker, content scripts, optional and required permissions, host permissions, DNR, side panel, and risky external messaging.
Malformed JSON, missing manifest, oversized manifest, non-MV3 input, and stable JSON output are tested.
A public-safety check rejects likely secrets, email addresses, personal Windows paths, unrelated brand references, and parent-directory traversal in tracked public files.
No network call, telemetry, browser access, new runtime dependency, commit, push, or package publication is introduced.
stopConditions: Any required file or fact exists only outside this repository.
A requested change would require credentials, a browser profile, or a network call.
The same failing approach has been attempted three times.
The configured model is not stealth/ox-alpha or it is rate-limited.
deliverable: Implement the changes, run the allowed tests, and finish with a compact JSON summary containing changedFiles, tests, risks, and blockers.
